market_question: Will Ivan Cepeda Castro win the 2026 Colombian presidential election?
reasoning: Early polls for 2026 show Cepeda with low single-digit support, far behind leaders from across the spectrum. The left faces headwinds from President Petro's unpopularity, and Cepeda would need to consolidate a fractured field and win a runoff. A 40.5% implied chance is inconsistent with his current polling and the structural challenges he faces.
evidence_points: Invamer July 2024 open presidential poll placed Cepeda at 4.6%, far behind Vicky Dávila (14.4%) and others.
President Petro's approval rating has been below 35%, signaling strong anti-incumbent sentiment that will likely hurt left-wing candidates.
The Colombian electoral system requires a second round if no candidate exceeds 50%, making it hard for any single outsider to win without broad alliances, which Cepeda has not yet built.
sources_consulted: Gallup Colombia approval ratings for Gustavo Petro
